description: §4.12.2 / §52.13.2 (S449 ruling item 4) — `auth=` on a NESTED `<program>` is E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH whatever its value, and that is its ONE diagnostic: an unrecognized value there does not also raise E-AUTH-ATTR-INVALID or W-ATTR-002 (no stacked messages for one declaration).
rationale: §34 E-PROGRAM-NESTED-AUTH: 'Fires for any value (a literal, an interpolation, or bare)'. §52.13.2 as amended S449 excludes the nested `<program>`. Ruling: user-voice-scrml.md S449 "RULED — 'your recs.'" item 4 — 'Unrecognized / non-literal `auth=` (incl. `""`) = (a): compile error; amend §52.13.2 (supersedes its W-ATTR-002 + "no auth gate" SHALL).'
